_note: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Available water capacity (field capacity minus wilting point) in mm of water per m of root zone. Check every value against its source before use.

sand.source: FAO-56 Table 19 (theta_FC minus theta_WP for sand, 0.05 to 0.11 m3/m3); value is the range midpoint

loam.source: FAO-56 Table 19 (theta_FC minus theta_WP for loam, 0.11 to 0.20 m3/m3); value is the range midpoint

clay.source: FAO-56 Table 19 (theta_FC minus theta_WP for clay, 0.12 to 0.20 m3/m3); value is the range midpoint
